content_html:
Built a Burning Bridges–style AI video tool for the crystal-chandelier party template (Drake-inspired fan tool — not affiliated with Drake / OVO / Republic / UMG).

Primary: https://burningbridgesvideoai.com Also: https://burnbridgesai.video

What you get

  • Upload 1–2 adult face photos → multi-shot party clip (~15–25s, 16:9, 720p MP4)
  • Locked motion beats: hat / silver cup / collar pull / hand-to-brow gesture
  • MP4 with sound by default (trend-style audio in the render)
  • Preview framing before you pay
  • Cloudflare Workers deploy; samples are self-generated (no scraped competitor demos)

Pricing (credits)

  • Single $4.99 → 1 video
  • Popular $9.90 → 3 videos (≈$3.30 each)
  • Creator $24.90 → 10 videos (≈$2.49 each) 18+ only; authorized photos; no celebrity/MV stills.

Want blunt feedback on: homepage clarity, sample quality, and whether the pricing feels off. Roast away — thanks.
